meta.title: City Ordinances of Marikina (as listed on the Full Disclosure Portal)

sources.covers: Number, title and PDF link as listed on the portal

meta.notes: Coverage: series of 2000 to 2026; 149 ordinances. This is only what the portal lists, not the full set of enacted ordinances; the series 2000-2026 has large gaps. approvedDate is null because the portal lists number and title only; the date is inside each PDF. Categories are assigned by keyword matching on the title and are not part of the source. Some numbers repeat on the portal with different titles (kept as listed).
